title: Yap Later money proposal v1
description: What the on-device model returns for one spoken sentence. Untrusted: app code validates every field before anything is stored. A reminder's details come from a second model step (see docs/CONTRACTS.md).

amount.description: Dollars exactly as said; null when no amount was said.

date_phrase.description: The words about when, e.g. 'yesterday'. Resolved in app code.
